reasoning: 驗證目標：選取 Edit FAVs 類別時，可逐筆刪除演出者或歌曲名稱條目，或以 Delete All 一次刪除全部。為什麼這樣切：與 126 的條款內容重疊，差異僅在類別名稱（A-SX17），切分依該唯一差異，本 leaf 由 Edit FAVs 進入；本條款另明白點名 'Delete All' 這個功能名稱，故 ER 以該名稱指涉。刪除前的確認畫面屬 130（§8.2.1）。

tcs.tc_title: Edit FAVs deletes an individual entry and offers Delete All
tcs.test_item: When the Edit FAVs category is selected, the HU shall allow selection to either delete an individual entry of favorite artist or song title in the list or a Delete All function to delete all current favorite artist/song titles
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. Three favorites are stored, of which at least one is an artist and at least one is a song title
5. The Favorites browse content is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Select the Edit FAVs category and read the offered options
2. Delete one individual entry and read the favorites
3. Use the Delete All function and read the favorites
tcs.expected_result:
1. Deleting an individual entry and a Delete All function are both offered
2. The deleted entry is gone and the other two are unchanged
3. No favorite remains
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: Same-text sibling: CFTS024-4872927 (category-name entry is the distinguishing token)
